title: Excubia push envelope
description: Protocol version 1 of the body that excubia push sends to POST {appUrl}/api/reports with Authorization: Bearer <project token>. The app stores a repeated batchId once. Frozen at 1.0.0.

batchId.description: Random UUID version 4, new for every run. A retry of the same send keeps it.

sentAt.description: UTC time the report was built for sending, Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z.
